sentences.en: The city's convention center was converted into a make-shift hospital.
sentences.zh: 这个城市的会议中心被改造成了一家临时医院。

sentences.en: Yanni was on his way to a convention in Algiers.
sentences.zh: 杨尼正前往阿尔及尔参加一个会议。

sentences.en: That's one of the conventions of our daily life.
sentences.zh: 这是我们日常生活中的一种惯例。

mnemonic: 词根记忆：con（共同）+vent（来）+ ion→大家共同来遵守的东西→习俗
